snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Amidst Wings of Gray Preview Video
snippet.description:
Commanders, the brand-new Elite Doll Daiyan, her Elite Weapon [Heavy Strings], and her exclusive Outfit [Narcissus] will be released on January 16, 13:00 (GMT+0)! 
At the same time, the fully voiced, limited-time Themed Event [Amidst Wings of Gray] will also be available!
